item.title: 3 Months and no update, 31st July
item.description:
The paving stones out the front of Chaplais Cafe and Guild Craft Shop in Montpellier. A company allied to the council came along about 3 months ago and erected large bright orange barriers over some of the steps - I am assuming for heath and safety reasons, the steps have been like that for years tho. They then went away again and nothing has happened since, I mentioned it to a couple of council representatives and again nothing has happened. The barriers cause more health and safety issues than the steps and recently I watched a lady on a motorised wheel chair struggle up the ramp and past one of the barriers. The public are beginning to query it too.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 10, Montpellier Street, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Fire hazard and noxious verges at entrance to Tallis Road, 31st July
item.description:
The two grass verges at the entrance to Tallis Road are extremely overgrown, extremely dry making a fire hazard, and contain noxious weeds, including heracleum mantegazzianum & jacobaea vulgaris, as well as many weeds hazardous to people and animals, such as dogs being walked plus cats. Both of these verges are now so very overgrown and would probably require industrial grass cutting apparatus plus PPE to be worn so as to be safely cut. As of 31 Jul 2026 this has been a serious concern for over 8 weeks. In the past residents have cut them back with scythes and simmers etc but it is now too unsafe to do so with normal domestic equipment. Would you arrange for these verges to be cut professionally and safely please. Thank you.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Trafalgar Drive, Churchdown, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
